hazards.name: Wide Painted Median
hazards.description: The wide, flush painted median increases the overall crossing distance and can encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Obstructed Narrow Sidewalk
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed directly in the narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to maneuver around them, potentially into the street.

hazards.name: Narrow, Constrained Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the far side is very narrow and hemmed in by a high metal fence, leaving no room for pedestrians to pass or avoid hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Far side of the roadway, running parallel to the fence

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no paved, separated walkways on either side of the street, forcing pedestrians to share space with vehicles or walk on uneven dirt shoulders.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible stretch.

hazards.name: Poor Walkway Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk is severely cracked and uneven, creating significant trip hazards.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a marked crosswalk or refuge island.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the left curb can block sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming drivers.

hazards.name: Wide Multi-lane Roadway
hazards.description: The road has four or more lanes with no pedestrian refuge or marked crossings, encouraging high vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: There is no paved, separated walkway for pedestrians, forcing them onto the unpaved shoulder or into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible block

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes and a lack of vertical elements like trees or buildings at the sidewalk edge encourage high vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes in the center of the image

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway lacks any marked crossings or refuge islands, making it dangerous for pedestrians to cross between industrial sites.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the roadway

hazards.name: Sidewalk Parking
hazards.description: Vehicles are parked entirely on the pedestrian walkway, completely obstructing the path and forcing pedestrians to walk in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground, silver and red cars parked on the right side of the image.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway and Multiple Lanes
hazards.description: The large number of travel lanes and wide road profile encourage high vehicle speeds and increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Protection
hazards.description: Flexible bollards provide visual separation but offer no physical protection for pedestrians or cyclists from errant vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Yellow bollards in the center-left of the roadway

hazards.name: Undefined vehicle access
hazards.description: The large open lot creates a wide, undefined area where vehicles may cross the sidewalk, increasing conflict points.
hazards.location_in_image: The perimeter of the vacant lot adjacent to the sidewalk

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with signage and potentially a pedestrian refuge island in the center turn lane to facilitate safer crossings.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to encourage slower driving speeds and shorten the pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Reconfigure the wide roadway to include dedicated bike lanes, which would narrow the travel lanes and naturally slow traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a buffer zone with street trees or planters to separate the walkway from the roadway and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk on the right side of the roadway to provide a continuous pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to facilitate safe crossings.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk and Curbing
interventions.description: Install a standard raised curb and a wider, ADA-compliant sidewalk to provide physical and vertical separation from motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to increase the distance between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Designated Parking Markings
interventions.description: If parking is to be permitted, use clear pavement markings to define parking stalls and prevent vehicles from encroaching on the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island in the center turn lane to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical protection and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lower-height lighting fixtures specifically for the sidewalk to improve visibility and perceived safety.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Install physical barriers between the bike lane and the travel lane to protect cyclists and provide a buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a raised pedestrian refuge island in the center median to reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Install Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Complete Sidewalk Network
interventions.description: Construct a sidewalk on the near side of the road to provide a continuous and safe path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing/Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce lane widths or repurpose excess pavement to slow traffic and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions and Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Implement a marked mid-block crossing with curb extensions to shorten crossing distances and increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a safety buffer from moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale and roadway lighting to improve visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide a physical and psychological buffer between the wide sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Raised Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Replace the painted median with a raised concrete island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians and reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffer
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and add a landscape buffer or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk and Refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Infrastructure
interventions.description: Install continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repave the sidewalk to provide a smooth, continuous, and ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Physical Parking Barriers
interventions.description: Install bollards or a raised curb buffer to prevent vehicles from parking on and obstructing the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk and a raised pedestrian refuge island in the median to break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffering
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees between the new sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Bollard Installation
interventions.description: Install permanent bollards along the curb line to prevent vehicles from mounting and parking on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Consolidated Driveways
interventions.description: Replace the wide open access with defined, narrow driveways to minimize the pedestrian-vehicle conflict zone.
